message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market feeds built into this environment, so I can’t pull up today’s exact BTC/USD quote right now.  

If you need the most recent price, here are some quick ways to get it:

| Method | How |
|--------|-----|
| **Websites** | Check major exchanges (Coinbase, Binance) or aggregate sites like CoinMarketCap / CoinGecko. |
| **APIs** | Use public APIs – e.g., `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd` returns JSON `{ "bitcoin": { "usd": <value> }}`. |
| **Widgets** | Embed a small widget on your site/dashboard if you’re building something interactive. |

Let me know if you'd like help writing code to call one of those APIs!
